args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and service reported unhealthy. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback approved and completed. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18 and unhealthy status.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Checked service status and deployment history. The deployment history showed:
   - v2.2.9: healthy in production
   - v2.3.0: healthy in production (most recent healthy release)
   - v2.3.1: unhealthy in production (latest deploy)

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback was approved and completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and noting that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.
